answer_1.quote: This study examines the impact of linguistic similarity on human-chatbot interactions to better understand effective personalization.
datasets: Corpus of Regional African American Language
answer_1.outputs: text responses in African American English (AAE) and spoken chatbot outputs with African American accent

answer_2.quote: We develop an automatic approach for tagging AAE linguistic features present in the generated responses, which leverages a large language model to identify and label spans in the response that incorporate AAE features.
